name: Osprey Field
tagline: Turn every rooftop, tower, and turbine flight into a report clients trust.
positioning: Osprey Field is the drone inspection platform for owner-operators — capture, annotate, and deliver client-ready reports without a back-office team.

hero.h1: Fly once. Deliver a report that closes the next job.
hero.sub: Osprey Field turns raw drone footage into branded, geotagged inspection reports in minutes — so solo pilots and small crews look like the biggest firm on the bid.

features.title: Flight-to-report in one pass
features.description: Land the drone, tag the defects on your phone, and export a client-ready PDF before you leave the site. No desktop editing marathon required.

features.title: Defect pins that stick
features.description: Drop annotations directly on 4K stills and orthomaps. Every crack, corrosion spot, and loose panel keeps its GPS coordinate and timestamp.

features.title: Your logo on every page
features.description: Reports carry your brand, license number, and colors automatically — so a two-person shop hands over paperwork that reads like an enterprise deliverable.

features.title: Airspace, checked for you
features.description: Pre-flight LAANC status, weather windows, and no-fly warnings surface before you unfold the props. Fewer scrubbed jobs, fewer awkward client calls.

features.title: Job history that answers itself
features.description: Every past inspection is searchable by address and asset, so the 'can you re-send that roof report?' email takes ten seconds, not an hour.

features.title: Bill by the seat, not the surprise
features.description: Add a pilot when you hire one, remove them when the season ends. Predictable per-seat pricing with no per-report tolls.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend Sunday nights stitching photos into Word docs. Now the roof report is signed off before I pack the truck. Osprey Field basically gave me my weekends back.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deel

testimonials.quote: Property managers stopped questioning my findings once the reports had geotagged defect pins. It made a one-man operation look like a regional firm — and my close rate proves it.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: We added two seasonal pilots for storm season and dropped them in November. The per-seat billing meant I never paid for a crew I didn't have flying.
testimonials.name: Cole Ferraro
